 Prayer:

Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution   to issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to consider the  representation of the petitioner dated 28.03.2022 under Section 18(1)
 Land Acquisition Act to the Competent Court for the enhanced  compensation.
For Petitioner : Mr.M.Durai Murugan  For R1 to R3 : Mrs. V.Yamunadevi  Special Government Pleader  ORDER

Though this Writ Petition is filed seeking a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 28.03.2022 under Section 18(1) of the Land Acquisition Act to the Competent Court for the enhanced compensation, this petition is bereft of particulars.
Therefore, this Court is not inclined to entertain this Writ Petition.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.
Accordingly, this Writ Petition is dismissed at the admission stage itself.
No costs.
